rules.alternatives: Only a nurse who has not practiced (paid or volunteer) in the 5 years before renewal must prove competency with one of: a board-approved reorientation program, 20 contact hours of nursing CE from the last 2 years from a recognized credentialing agency (e.g. ANCC), or 3 semester hours of nursing credit from the last 2 years.
rules.notes: State law does not make CE a condition of RN renewal; nurses are expected to keep their own competency. The CE rule (Part 2815) was repealed in 2020. Licenses expire December 31 of even-numbered years.
rules.legal_basis: 30 Miss. Admin. Code, Part 2810, Chapter 4, Rule 4.7
